headline: Rupiah Opens This Morning at Rp18,258
summary: The Indonesian rupiah weakened against the US dollar at the open of trading on Friday, November 20, 2026, opening at Rp18,258.
why: The rupiah is Indonesia's currency, and its moves against the dollar affect the cost of dollar-denominated debt and imports for Indonesian companies and the central bank's policy stance.
original_headline: Rupiah Pagi Ini Dibuka ke Rp18.258
